subScenes.name: 偶遇祝福
subScenes.description: 朋友在商场偶遇，互相送上圣诞或新年祝福。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 节日偶遇时，朋友/同事主动送上节日祝福，你如何回应？

followUps.text: Thanks! Same to you — hope you have a wonderful break!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！你也一样，祝你度过一个美好的假期！

followUps.text: Oh, thanks! I’m actually just rushing to a meeting, but I really appreciate it!
followUps.text_cn: 哦，谢谢！我正赶着去开会，但真的很感谢你！

followUps.text: Hey, happy holidays to you too! Are you heading home for the holidays?
followUps.text_cn: 嘿，你也节日快乐！你假期回家吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于节日偶遇时的自然回应，根据关系亲疏和时间状况选择不同语气的回应方式。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在办公室偶遇时说圣诞快乐，你如何回应？

followUps.text: Merry Christmas! I’m planning to have a quiet one this year.
followUps.text_cn: 圣诞快乐！今年我打算过个安静的假期。

followUps.text: Thanks! I’m not really celebrating, but I hope you have a great day!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我不太庆祝，但希望你今天过得愉快！

followUps.text: Merry Christmas! Let’s grab coffee after the holidays — my treat!
followUps.text_cn: 圣诞快乐！假期后我们喝杯咖啡吧，我请客！

qaPairs.usageNote: 在职场或熟人圈中，节日问候常伴随轻度社交延伸，回应可含个人状态或未来互动暗示。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 在超市或街头偶遇熟人，对方说新年快乐，你如何回应？

followUps.text: Happy New Year! I’m hoping this year’s better than the last one.
followUps.text_cn: 新年快乐！希望今年比去年好得多。

followUps.text: You too! Oh, I’ve got to run — but have an amazing year!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！哦，我得走了——但祝你这一年超棒！

followUps.text: Happy New Year! Did you make any resolutions?
followUps.text_cn: 新年快乐！你有什么新年计划吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 节日偶遇中，新年问候最常见，回应可依情绪、时间、关系灵活调整，避免机械重复‘谢谢’。

subScenes.name: 询问假期
subScenes.description: 询问对方假期有何计划，表达兴趣与关心。

qaPairs.triggerText: What are you doing for the holidays?

followUps.text: I'm heading to the mountains for a few days—just relaxing.
followUps.text_cn: 我要去山里待几天，纯粹放松一下。

followUps.text: Honestly? I'm just staying home and catching up on sleep.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话，我就待在家补觉。

followUps.text: I haven't decided yet—I'm waiting to hear if my sister can visit.
followUps.text_cn: 我还没决定，等我妹妹能不能来再定。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友间自然询问假期计划，回应可体现个人偏好或现实限制，避免过于正式。

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you taking any time off soon?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事间试探对方假期安排

followUps.text: Yes, I’ve got a week off in December—finally!
followUps.text_cn: 是的，十二月我有一周假，终于！

followUps.text: Not this year—I’ve got too many deadlines.
followUps.text_cn: 今年不行，手头项目太多了。

followUps.text: Maybe—I’m trying to swap shifts with someone.
followUps.text_cn: 可能吧，我在试着和别人调班。

qaPairs.usageNote: 职场朋友间常见试探性提问，回应需体现真实工作压力或灵活安排，避免笼统回答如'I'm fine'。

qaPairs.triggerText: Any plans for the long weekend?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这个长周末有什么计划？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友间闲聊短假期安排

followUps.text: I’m meeting up with some friends for a picnic—hope the weather holds!
followUps.text_cn: 我和几个朋友约了野餐，希望天气别糟。

followUps.text: Nah, I’m just going to binge-watch that new series.
followUps.text_cn: 算了，我就追新剧了。

followUps.text: I’m not sure—I might visit my parents, but I haven’t called them yet.
followUps.text_cn: 还不确定，可能会去看爸妈，但还没打电话问。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于轻松社交场景，回应应体现真实生活选择，避免机械式回答，保留口语化语气和不确定性表达。

subScenes.name: 分享计划
subScenes.description: 分享自己的节日安排，如聚会或旅行。

qaPairs.triggerText: What are you doing for the holidays?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友间节日假期计划分享

followUps.text: I'm going to visit my parents in the countryside.
followUps.text_cn: 我要去乡下看望父母。

followUps.text: Honestly, I haven't decided yet—I might just relax at home.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话我还没决定，可能就在家休息。

followUps.text: I’m thinking of traveling, but I’m still waiting to hear back from my boss about time off.
followUps.text_cn: 我考虑去旅行，但还在等老板回复我假期申请。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友间自然询问节日安排，回应应体现真实生活状态，避免过于正式或笼统。

qaPairs.triggerText: Any plans for New Year’s Eve?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事间新年活动邀约前的试探性询问

followUps.text: Yeah, I’m hosting a small dinner with a few friends.
followUps.text_cn: 有啊，我打算和几个朋友在家办个小聚餐。

followUps.text: Nah, I’m probably just watching movies and calling family.
followUps.text_cn: 算了，我可能就看看电影，给家人打个电话。

followUps.text: I was invited to a party, but I’m not sure if I’ll go—I’m pretty tired this week.
followUps.text_cn: 有人邀请我去派对，但我还不确定去不去，这周太累了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应需体现个人偏好与现实约束，避免机械回答'yes'或'no'，增加生活感。

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you doing anything special for Christmas?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 圣诞节有什么特别安排吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事间节日问候与计划交流

followUps.text: We’re flying to see my sister—she lives abroad.
followUps.text_cn: 我们要飞去见我妹妹，她住在国外。

followUps.text: Not really—I’m just going to catch up on sleep and binge-watch my favorite show.
followUps.text_cn: 没什么特别的，就想补觉和追剧。

followUps.text: I’m volunteering at the local shelter—I’ve done it for years.
followUps.text_cn: 我会去当地收容所做志愿者，我已经连续好几年这样做了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应应展现个性与文化差异，避免千篇一律的'go to dinner'，鼓励表达真实生活选择。

subScenes.name: 礼貌告别
subScenes.description: 自然结束对话，再次祝福并道别。

qaPairs.triggerText: Well, I should head out — have a great evening!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嗯，我该走了——祝你今晚愉快！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友或同事在节日聚会结束时礼貌告别

followUps.text: Thanks for coming! Have a safe trip home!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你来！路上小心！

followUps.text: Same to you! Let’s catch up before the next holiday!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！咱们节前再聚一次吧！

followUps.text: Yeah, me too — this was such a fun night!
followUps.text_cn: 是啊，我也是——今晚太开心了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于节日聚会、年会或节日前夕的非正式告别场景，回应对方的礼貌道别时保持温暖、自然

qaPairs.triggerText: I’ve got to run — happy holidays!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在节前下班时匆忙告别

followUps.text: Happy holidays to you too! See you next year!
followUps.text_cn: 你也节日快乐！明年见！

followUps.text: Wait, can you send me that recipe you mentioned? Happy holidays!
followUps.text_cn: 等一下，你能把刚才说的食谱发我一下吗？节日快乐！

followUps.text: You too! Enjoy your time off — you’ve earned it!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！好好休息吧，你值得！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于职场或半正式社交场合，回应匆忙但友好的告别，可灵活加入轻量请求或情感反馈

qaPairs.triggerText: It’s been wonderful catching up — I’ll let you get back to your family!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 和你聊得太开心了——我不打扰你和家人团聚了！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友在节日家庭聚会中主动结束对话，体谅对方家庭时间

followUps.text: Thank you for coming — we’d love to have you over again soon!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你来！我们很快再请你来！

followUps.text: I really appreciate you making time — happy holidays!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你抽空来，节日快乐！

followUps.text: Same! Give my best to everyone at home!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！代我向家里人问好！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于节日家庭聚会后的告别，强调尊重对方家庭时间，回应需体现体贴与情感温度

subScenes.name: 回应寒暄
subScenes.description: 回应对方的节日问候，表达感谢与回祝。

qaPairs.triggerText: Happy holidays! How’s everything going with you?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 节日快乐！你最近怎么样？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 节日寒暄中回应朋友的关心

followUps.text: Thanks! Everything’s good — just relaxing with family this week.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！一切都好，这周正和家人一起放松呢。

followUps.text: Not bad, but I’ve been swamped with work. Hope you’re having a better break!
followUps.text_cn: 还行，但最近工作忙得不可开交，希望你假期过得更轻松！

followUps.text: To be honest, I’m just taking it easy — no big plans, but that’s fine by me.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话，我就是随便过过，没什么计划，但这样也挺好。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友或同事在节日期间表达关心时的自然回应，语气应轻松真诚，避免过度夸张或冷漠。

qaPairs.triggerText: Merry Christmas! Did you get any fun plans for the break?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 圣诞快乐！假期有什么有趣的安排吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 节日问候中回应关于假期计划的询问

followUps.text: Yeah, I’m heading to my parents’ house — can’t wait to eat all the cookies!
followUps.text_cn: 是啊，我要回父母家，超期待吃光他们做的所有饼干！

followUps.text: Not yet — I’m still deciding. Maybe just stay in and binge-watch shows.
followUps.text_cn: 还没定呢，可能就在家追剧吧。

followUps.text: Actually, I’m working a shift on Christmas Day — but at least I get time off after!
followUps.text_cn: 其实我圣诞节那天要上班，但之后能补休，也算不错了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应关于假期计划的问题时，应根据真实情况选择坦诚、轻松或略带幽默的语气，避免生硬拒绝或过度承诺。

qaPairs.triggerText: Happy New Year! Hope you had a wonderful time!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 新年快乐！希望你度过了美好的时光！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 节后寒暄中回应对方对节日体验的关心

followUps.text: I did! We had a big dinner with friends and watched the fireworks — perfect end to the year.
followUps.text_cn: 是的！和朋友吃了大餐，还看了烟花，完美收官！

followUps.text: It was quiet, but really nice — just me and my cat, lots of cozy movies.
followUps.text_cn: 挺安静的，但很舒服，就我和猫，看了好多温馨电影。

followUps.text: To be honest, it was a bit stressful — family drama, you know? But I’m glad it’s over.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话，有点压力，你知道的，家人之间有点矛盾，不过总算过去了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 节后寒暄中回应他人关心时，应根据真实感受选择积极、中性或略带真实情绪的回应，体现自然的人际互动。
